app.alreadyOpenBody: Only one Steps runs at a time, so we've brought this one to the front for you.
app.name: Steps

merge.title: Merge guides
merge.help: Steps makes a new guide from the ones you choose, in this order. The originals stay as they are.
merge.noneChosen: Tick two or more guides to merge.
merge.headings: Start each guide with a heading
merge.headingsHelp: Its title, as a header block. The PDF's contents page lists each part.
merge.binOriginals: Move the originals to the Bin afterwards
merge.binOriginalsHelp: Undo brings them back. Any someone else is editing stay where they are.

library.heading: Your guides
library.pendingTitle: A recording is not saved yet
library.pendingBody_one: “{{title}}”, {{count}} step. Nothing is lost until you discard it.
library.pendingBody_other: “{{title}}”, {{count}} steps. Nothing is lost until you discard it.
library.pendingBodyNoCount: “{{title}}”. Nothing is lost until you discard it.
library.pendingCleanupTitle: A saved recording needs tidying up
library.pendingCleanupBody: “{{title}}” was saved, but its temporary files are still here.
library.loadFailed: The guides could not be loaded.
library.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.

empty.title: No guides yet
empty.body: Press New recording, do the task as normal, and it becomes a step-by-step guide.

library.copied: Copied to {{name}}. Its versions and comments stayed with the original.
library.applyBlurConfirm: The blur in “{{title}}” will be burned into its screenshots for good, in its saved versions too, and the unblurred originals deleted. Anyone with access to the library will only ever see the blurred screenshots. This can’t be undone. Continue?
library.noBlurToApply: Nothing is blurred in this guide, so nothing changed.

bulk.copied_one: {{count}} guide copied to “{{name}}”. Its versions and comments stayed with the original.
bulk.copied_other: {{count}} guides copied to “{{name}}”. Their versions and comments stayed with the originals.
bulk.editing: “{{title}}” was left alone: {{name}} is editing it.

selection.label: Guides selected
selection.copyHeading: Copy to (versions and comments stay behind)

library.trashHelp: Deleted guides stay here for 30 days, then go for good.
library.deleteForGoodBody: It can't be restored afterwards, by you or anyone else using this library. Its screenshots, versions and comments go with it.
library.emptyTrashBody_one: {{count}} guide will be deleted for good. It can't be restored afterwards, by you or anyone else using this library.
library.emptyTrashBody_other: {{count}} guides will be deleted for good. They can't be restored afterwards, by you or anyone else using this library.
library.renameLocked: {{name}} is editing this guide, so it can’t be renamed now. Try again once they’ve finished.

access.title: Allow access to “{{folder}}”
access.body: The browser asks again before Steps can open this library’s folder, for example after it restarts.

amlsteps.label: Steps file
amlsteps.pickTitle: Save the guide as a Steps file
amlsteps.done: Guide exported. Blurred areas are blurred for good in the file.
amlsteps.originalsWarning: The file will contain every screenshot without its blur. Anyone who gets it can see what was blurred. Only use this to hand a guide to a colleague who needs to edit the blur.
amlsteps.burnedIn: Blurred areas are blurred for good in the file. Hidden typed values, comments and versions are left out.

export.pdfNote: Branded, ready to print or send
export.wordNote: To keep editing in Word; the most accessible
export.copyNote: Paste into an email, Teams or SharePoint
export.webNote: An interactive walkthrough that plays step by step in any browser
export.copied: Copied. Paste it into your email, Teams message or page.
export.fontsMissing: Some characters had no font on this PC that can show them, so they may print as boxes.

languages.moreHelp: Each makes its own file, with the language in its name.
languages.pageHelp: Visitors see it in their browser’s language and can switch. Texts you wrote but haven’t written in a language show in {{main}}.
languages.justHelp: Visitors see it in this language only.
languages.notWritten_one: {{count}} text you wrote isn’t in {{name}} yet, so it exports in {{main}}.
languages.notWritten_other: {{count}} texts you wrote aren’t in {{name}} yet, so they export in {{main}}.

export.pathCopied: Its location is copied, ready to paste.
export.draftSaved: The guide is saved in your library too.
export.failed: The export couldn’t be made. Please try again.
export.filmstrip: Screenshots as they will be exported
export.personalData: Check every screenshot for personal data before you share it. Automatic suggestions can miss things.
export.flagged_one: {{count}} step needs checking: an unnamed click, a name read from the screenshot, missed clicks, typing that may not match, or a screenshot to check.
export.flagged_other: {{count}} steps need checking: unnamed clicks, names read from screenshots, missed clicks, typing that may not match, or screenshots to check.
export.noFlagged: No steps are flagged for checking.
export.blurBurned_one: {{count}} blurred area is blurred for good in the export.
export.blurBurned_other: {{count}} blurred areas are blurred for good in the export.
export.contentsHelp_one: Lists the guide’s {{count}} section, from its header block.
export.contentsHelp_other: Lists the guide’s {{count}} sections, from its header blocks.
export.controlHelp: Owner, dates, review date and the saved versions.
export.controlHelpDraft: Owner, dates and review date. Versions are listed once the guide is saved.
export.compact: Compact: two steps to a page
export.webWorks: It plays in any browser when opened from a file, a shared drive or an email attachment. It won’t play inside an email or straight from SharePoint or Teams: download it first, or use PDF or Copy to clipboard there.
export.publicSector: PDFs from Steps are tagged for screen readers. Before publishing one on a public-sector website, check it with an accessibility checker such as PAC, or export as Word.
export.notChecked_one: {{count}} screenshot couldn’t be checked for personal data (text recognition isn’t available). Check it yourself.
export.notChecked_other: {{count}} screenshots couldn’t be checked for personal data (text recognition isn’t available). Check them yourself.
export.secretLike_one: {{count}} typed value shown looks like it could be a password.
export.secretLike_other: {{count}} typed values shown look like they could be passwords.
export.missingImages_one: {{count}} screenshot couldn’t be loaded, so its step exports without a picture.
export.missingImages_other: {{count}} screenshots couldn’t be loaded, so their steps export without a picture.
export.noUnblurred: No personal data was found unblurred (suggestions can miss things).
export.optimised: Pictures are made smaller for sharing (Settings → Export).

panel.intro: Record a task in this browser, click by click. Each click becomes a step with a screenshot.
panel.clickToRecord: Do the task in any tab. Each click shows here as a step.
panel.ready: Your recording is ready to review.
panel.failed: That didn't work. Try again, or reload the extension.
panel.excluded: {{site}} won't be recorded. Steps already recorded there stay until you delete them.

comments.title: Review comments
comments.placeholder: Only people with this library see comments. They're never exported.

lock.readOnly: {{name}} is editing this guide (since {{time}}). You can read it, and their changes show here as they sync.
lock.takeOverBody: {{name}} can't save their changes here any more: what they haven't saved yet is kept as a draft on the guide. Changes they made in the last few minutes may not have synced yet, so take over only if they're done, or can't finish.
lock.refused: {{name}} is editing this guide. Take over editing to make changes.
lock.lost: {{name}} took over editing this guide, so it's read-only here now.
lock.keptAsDraft: Your unsaved changes are kept as a draft on this guide.
lock.draftFailed: Your unsaved changes couldn't be kept as a draft.

conflicts.step: This step was changed in two places at once (one copy from {{from}}). Choose which to keep:
conflicts.guide: This guide's details were changed in two places at once (one copy from {{from}}). Choose which to keep:
conflicts.restored: {{deletedBy}} deleted the step "{{text}}", but {{editedBy}} changed it meanwhile, so it's back.

drafts.banner_one: Unsaved changes by {{name}} from {{when}} ({{count}} step), kept when someone else took over editing.
drafts.banner_other: Unsaved changes by {{name}} from {{when}} ({{count}} steps), kept when someone else took over editing.

editor.title: Guide title

languages.nextMissing: Go to the next text not written in {{name}} yet
languages.notWritten: Not written in {{name}} yet: this is the {{main}}. Change it to write it in {{name}}.
languages.dialogHelp: Recorded steps are worded again from what was recorded, in the language and tone you choose. Steps changed by hand stay as they are unless you tick them. One Undo takes it all back.
languages.mainLanguageHelp: The language this guide is written in. Anything written in other languages is kept.

toneHelp.casual: Short, as Steps has always worded steps
toneHelp.plain: Everyday words, as public-sector style guides ask
toneHelp.formal: Full sentences, for procedures and policies

languages.keptEdited_one: {{count}} changed by hand stays as it is.
languages.keptEdited_other: {{count}} changed by hand stay as they are.
languages.versionNote: Before changing the language or tone

editor.introHelp: Who the guide is for, and anything they need first.
editor.introPlaceholder: For example: you need adviser access in Xero.
editor.outroHelp: What the reader has achieved, and what to do next.
editor.outroPlaceholder: For example: the new supplier now appears in your contacts.
editor.reviewRequired: Check this step: the recording couldn’t name what was clicked, some clicks were missed here, the typing may not match exactly, or a secret couldn’t be found in the screenshot to blur.

review.unnamed: Check this step: the recording couldn’t name what was clicked. Write what it was, or choose Looks right.
review.checkName: Check this name: it was read from the screenshot.
review.missed: Check this step: some clicks were missed here.
review.typing: Check this step: what was typed may not match exactly.
review.code: Check this step: a secret in it couldn’t be found in the screenshot to blur, or the text may not match exactly.

editor.altTextHelp: What the screenshot shows, for people who can't see it. Left empty, the step's wording is used.
editor.removeValue: Remove the typed value for good

code.copyFailed: That couldn’t be copied. Select the text and copy it instead.
code.maskedNote: Anything typed after -Password, -Token or a similar name shows as •••• here and is blurred in the screenshot. The real value is never saved.

editor.sharedLibraryBlur: Blur hides text in exports. People with access to this library can still open the original screenshot, and see hidden typed values. Use Apply blur permanently in the guide menu to remove the originals.
editor.valueTakenOut: The typed value was also taken out of your wording.
editor.replaceEditedText: You changed this step's wording by hand. Replace it with the standard wording?
editor.valueNotFound: You changed this step's wording by hand, and “{{value}}” isn't in it as typed, so it may still be there in another form. Use the standard wording instead? Your changes to the wording are replaced.
editor.notesPlaceholder: Add a note: a tip, a warning or some context

image.label: Screenshot
image.keys: With a drawing tool chosen, Enter adds its mark in the middle. Page Down picks the next mark. Arrow keys move it, Shift and arrow keys resize it, Delete removes it. Its position and size can also be typed in the boxes that appear in the corner.
image.none: This step has no screenshot. Paste one (Ctrl+V) or use Replace.
image.position: Position and size, as a percentage of the screenshot

editor.heading: Heading
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: What this guide shows, in a sentence or two
editor.reviewByHelp: The guide shows "Needs review" after this date.
editor.blockBodyPlaceholder: Write the text for this block
editor.saveFirstForImages: Save the guide first to add your own images
editor.imageFailed: That image couldn't be added. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.

menu.splitNote: Adds a step with the same screenshot
menu.blankStepNote: For something the recording couldn't see

dnd.start: Picked up a step. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel.
dnd.instructions: To move a step, press Space, use the arrow keys, then press Space again. Move up and Move down are also in each step's menu.

editor.replaceCleared: Screenshot replaced. Its blur areas, crop and highlight were for the old picture, so they’ve been removed: add blur again where it’s needed.

retake.title: Retake this screenshot
retake.body: Steps will minimise. Bring the window you want to the front: the new screenshot is taken when the countdown ends, the same way your recordings are (the window, or the whole screen).
retake.keepsMarks: The highlight, marks and blur areas stay where they are. Check they still line up afterwards.
retake.done: Screenshot retaken. Check the highlight and blur areas still line up.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.in: Zoom in (+, or Ctrl and the scroll wheel)
zoom.fit: Fit the screenshot to the space (now {{percent}}%)

versions.notePrompt: A short note for this version (optional)
versions.title: Versions
versions.help: Restoring a version saves the current guide as a version first, so nothing is lost.

welcome.tagline: Do it once. Get a how-to guide.

record.title: Record
record.body: Press New recording and do the task as normal.

tidy.title: Tidy up
tidy.body: Each click becomes a step with a screenshot. Reword, blur or remove.

share.title: Share
share.body: Save to a shared folder, or export a guide.

welcome.heading: Let's get you set up
welcome.folderHelp: Pick a OneDrive or SharePoint folder to share guides with your team. You can add more later.
welcome.importHelp: Got a settings file from a colleague or your IT team? Import it and these fill in for you.
welcome.managed: Your organisation has already set up libraries and privacy settings.

general.name: Your name
general.nameHelp: Shown as "Prepared by" on guides you share.
general.languageHelp: The language Steps is in, and the one new recordings are written in.
general.translated: Translated automatically. Spotted a mistake? Tell us at steps@amluto.com.
general.madeWithHelp: A small line at the end of every PDF, Word document, web page and copied guide, linking to steps.amluto.com.
general.autoStartHelp: Opens quietly in the system tray. You can also change this in Windows' Startup apps.
general.autoStartHelpLinux: Opens quietly in the system tray when you sign in to your desktop.
general.fileHelp: Copy your setup to another PC, or set up a team the same way. The file holds these settings, your shortcuts and excluded apps. Guides are not included.
general.managed: Your organisation manages these settings, so importing is switched off.
general.tourHelp: A short tour of the main window, in windows 1024 pixels wide or more.
general.tourNarrow: A short tour of the main window. This window is too narrow for it: make it 1024 pixels wide or more and the tour appears.

file.importedWithProblems_one: Settings imported, but {{count}} shortcut couldn't be set. Check Keyboard shortcuts.
file.importedWithProblems_other: Settings imported, but {{count}} shortcuts couldn't be set. Check Keyboard shortcuts.
file.invalid: That isn't a Steps settings file, or it was made by a newer version.

libraries.intro: A library is a folder of guides. Put one in a OneDrive or SharePoint folder and your team sees the same guides.
libraries.openFailed: The folder couldn't be opened. It may have been moved, or its drive isn't connected.
libraries.removeHelp: Removing a library from the list never deletes its guides.
libraries.note: Changing libraries never moves guides you already have.
libraries.browserIntro: “My guides” is kept in this browser. A folder you add is a library shared with Steps on the desktop and with anyone the folder is synced with. The browser may ask you to allow access to it again, for example after a restart.

recording.intro: Changes apply from your next recording.
recording.locked: Save or discard your recording before changing these.
recording.toneHelp: How the steps of new recordings are worded. Casual is Steps' own short style; Plain language uses everyday words; Formal writes full sentences. Any guide can be reworded later with Language and tone.
recording.qualityHelp: Original keeps every pixel, at your screen's full size, in files several times larger. Balanced is sharp and small enough to share.
recording.hideBar: Hide the recording bar from screenshots
recording.hideBarHelp: You still see it, but screenshots show what's behind it. Screen sharing, such as in Teams, doesn't show it either.
recording.appSwitch: Add a step when you switch apps
recording.appSwitchHelp: An "Open" step, such as Open "Excel", each time you move to another app.
recording.outputWaitHelp: How long a command's output must stay unchanged before it's taken as finished.
recording.typedOff: Your organisation has switched this off: recordings have clicks and screenshots only.
recording.excludedHelp: Clicks in these apps are skipped, with no screenshot.
recording.appName: App to exclude, for example keepass.exe
recording.appInvalid: Type the app's program name, for example keepass.exe.
recording.appNameLinux: App to exclude, for example keepassxc
recording.appInvalidLinux: Type the app's program name, for example keepassxc.
recording.inputSourceHelp: Only change this if Steps support asks you to.
recording.sitesHelp: Clicks and typing on these sites, and the sites under them, are skipped, with no screenshot.
recording.siteName: Site to exclude, for example bank.example
recording.siteInvalid: Type the site's address, for example bank.example.
recording.typedDefaultHelp: It can still be unticked for any recording. Commands, typing and shortcuts are recorded; passwords never are.
recording.outputDefaultHelp: Only with the one above. What commands print goes into the guide, so check it before sharing.
recording.unnamedTypingHelp: When the recording can't tell what you typed into (a document, or a box with no label), the step says only "Type" unless this is on. You can still show the text step by step.

shortcuts.intro: These work in any app, but only while you are recording, except Start a recording. To change one, press Change and then the new keys.
shortcuts.needModifier: Use Ctrl or Alt with a letter, number or F-key.
shortcuts.unavailable: Another app already uses this, so it doesn't work right now.
shortcuts.heldBySteps: Another copy of Steps is open and using this. Close it, then restart this one.
shortcuts.privacy: Only this box reads your keys, and only while it is waiting. Your shortcuts are switched off meanwhile.
shortcuts.startHelp: Can be the same as Stop: then one shortcut starts and stops.
shortcuts.sharedHelp: Start and Stop share this: it starts a recording, or stops one that's running.
shortcuts.addShortcutHelp: For recordings that don't record typing. Press these keys, then the shortcut you used (such as Ctrl+S): it becomes a "Press Ctrl+S" step with a screenshot.

appearance.appColoursHelp: A brand’s colours for Steps itself, checked so text stays readable in light and dark. The name and logo stay Steps.
appearance.pdfBrandHelp: Used for new exports; you can pick another brand for any single export.

about.madeByHelp: Steps is built and maintained by Amluto Solutions Ltd.
about.freeSoftwareHelp: You can share and change Steps under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. The names Amluto and Steps, and their logos, aren’t covered.
about.openSourceIntro: Steps is built on the work of {{count}} open-source components, used under their own licences: {{licences}}.
about.openSourceNote: The list comes from what this version actually ships. Each component's full licence text, and where to get the source of those under the MPL-2.0, is in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt with each release at github.com/amluto-solutions/steps.

cargo.title: Rust ({{count}})
cargo.help: The program itself: recording, screenshots, files and updates.

npm.title: JavaScript ({{count}})
npm.help: The screens: the library, the editor and the exports.

about.privacy: Steps keeps what it records on this PC or in the library folders you choose, and never sends it anywhere.
about.logsHelp: What the app did, kept for 30 days. They never include what you type, screenshots or text read from them.
about.helpHelp: Makes a support file with the logs, versions and settings, with your library names and folders and your name taken out. You see it before anything is sent.
about.bundleExplain: Nothing has been sent. It holds the files below. Look inside if you like. Write the email attaches it for you in Outlook or Thunderbird; with other email apps, the file is shown for you to attach.
about.failed: That didn’t work. Please try again.

link.desktop: Work with Steps for Chrome and Edge
link.desktopHelp: While Steps records, Steps for Chrome or Edge on this PC says what each click in a web page was, so the step reads as the page names it. Nothing leaves this PC.
link.browserHelp: While Steps for Windows records on this PC, this browser tells it what each click in a page was, so its steps read as they do here. Nothing from sites you don't record is included, and nothing leaves this PC.
link.waiting: Not connected yet: in Chrome or Edge, open Steps' Settings and switch on “Help Steps for Windows”.
link.register: Chrome and Edge couldn't be told where Steps is. Switch this off and on again to try again.
link.pipeTaken: Another copy of Steps is already working with Chrome and Edge on this PC.
link.pipe: The connection stopped. Switch this off and on again to start it.
link.notInstalled: Steps for Windows isn't on this PC, or it's the Microsoft Store edition, which can't connect yet. The setup from steps.amluto.com can.
link.notRunning: Steps for Windows isn't running. It connects within a minute of opening.
link.protocol: Steps for Windows and this extension need updating to the same version to connect.
link.permission: The browser didn't allow it. Switch this on again to be asked again.
link.store: Steps for Chrome and Edge can't connect to the Microsoft Store edition yet. The setup from steps.amluto.com can.

moveToLabel.left: Move the bar to the top left
moveToLabel.centre: Move the bar to the top centre
moveToLabel.right: Move the bar to the top right

recorder.startAgainHelp_one: Clears this {{count}} step and keeps recording
recorder.startAgainHelp_other: Clears these {{count}} steps and keeps recording
recorder.startedAgain_one: Started again. The earlier step was cleared.
recorder.startedAgain_other: Started again. The {{count}} earlier steps were cleared.
recorder.discardConfirmBody: Its steps and screenshots will be deleted. This can't be undone.
recorder.keysRecordedHelp: What you type is recorded. Pause stops it at once.
recorder.otherScreens_one: {{count}} click was on a screen this recording leaves out, so it isn't in the guide. To record on every screen, choose All monitors in Settings, Recording.
recorder.otherScreens_other: {{count}} clicks were on a screen this recording leaves out, so they aren't in the guide. To record on every screen, choose All monitors in Settings, Recording.
recorder.keysChoiceHelp: Commands, typing and shortcuts. Passwords are never kept.
recorder.outputChoiceHelp: What commands print. Check it before sharing.
recorder.keysOnlyNow: Keys are read during this recording only.

uac.title: Paused while Windows asks for permission
uac.body: Nothing on that screen can be recorded. Recording carries on when the prompt closes.

lock.title: Paused while the PC is locked
lock.body: Recording carries on when you unlock the PC.

excluded.title: Paused in an app you never record
excluded.body: Recording carries on when you switch to another app. Nothing in this one is recorded.

indicator.title: Paused because this bar stopped responding
indicator.body: Steps never records without showing that it is recording. Press Resume to carry on.

recorder.tryOtherInput: Try the other way of detecting clicks
recorder.elevatedWindowHelp: Clicks there may be missed. Use Capture now to add a screenshot step.
recorder.shortcutHelp: Press the keys you want this step to show.
recorder.shortcutPrivacy: Only this box reads the keys.
recorder.shortcutInvalid: Use a key with Ctrl, Alt or Windows, or a special key such as F5.
recorder.initializationFailed: The recorder could not finish starting. Restart Steps and try again.
recorder.commandFailed: The recorder could not do that. Please try again.
recorder.preferencesFailed: Settings could not be saved. Check the folder exists and that you can save files in it.
recorder.saveFailed: The guide could not be saved. Your recording is still here to try again.
recorder.stepsSkipped_one: {{count}} recorded step couldn't be read, so it was left out.
recorder.stepsSkipped_other: {{count}} recorded steps couldn't be read, so they were left out.

tidy.menuNote: Merge and remove the steps a recording doesn’t need
tidy.nothing: Nothing to tidy: this guide already looks neat.
tidy.title: Tidy guide
tidy.help: These changes are suggested. Untick any you want to keep as they are. One Undo takes them all back.

kinds.mergeClickIntoTyping: Merge the click into the typing that follows it: {{steps}}
kinds.removeOpenApp: Remove an “Open” step the next click already shows: {{steps}}
kinds.removeRedirect: Remove a “Go to” step the link only passed through: {{steps}}

storage.largeTitle: Your guides take {{size}} of browser storage
storage.lowSpaceTitle: Browser storage is nearly full: {{free}} left
storage.warningBody: Export guides you’re not using to .amlsteps files, then remove them from the browser. You can import them again any time.
storage.dialogHelp: Each guide you choose is saved as an .amlsteps file, with its original screenshots, in a folder you pick (in Firefox, your Downloads folder). Steps checks each file, then deletes the guide from the browser for good. It doesn’t go to the Bin.
storage.noneChosen: Choose the guides to move out of the browser.
storage.folderTitle: Choose a folder for the exported guides
storage.noFolder: No folder chosen, so nothing was removed.
storage.done_one: {{count}} guide exported and removed from the browser.
storage.done_other: {{count}} guides exported and removed from the browser.
storage.failed_one: {{count}} guide exported and removed. “{{title}}” couldn’t be saved, so it’s still here: {{reason}}
storage.failed_other: {{count}} guides exported and removed. “{{title}}” couldn’t be saved, so it’s still here: {{reason}}
storage.settingsUseFree: Your guides take {{size}}. The browser has {{free}} left.

backup.title: Back up everything
backup.help: Your settings, shortcuts, blur words, brands (with their logos and fonts) and the list of libraries, in one file. Guides stay in their library folders, so back those up with the folders themselves.
backup.managed: Your organisation manages these settings, so restoring is switched off.
backup.restored: Restored. Your settings, brands and libraries are as they were in the backup.
backup.problemShortcut: the “{{name}}” shortcut, which another app is using

confirm.title: Restore this backup?
confirm.intro: This file would change how Steps keeps things private or where it saves recordings:
confirm.excludedApps: • Start recording apps you keep out: {{list}}
confirm.typed: • Start recordings with “Record what’s typed” ticked
confirm.output: • Start recordings with “Include command output” ticked
confirm.unnamedTyping: • Show typing into boxes Steps can’t name

brands.intro: A brand sets the logo and colours of exported guides. Add a client’s brand to send them guides that look like their own.
brands.name: Name
brands.namePlaceholder: For example, the client’s company name
brands.logoInvalid: Use a PNG, JPEG or SVG logo of 1 MB or less.
brands.colourHex: Main colour as a hex code
brands.lowContrast: This colour is hard to read as text on white.
brands.footerPlaceholder: Optional, for example the client’s name
brands.alreadyCurrent: You already have this version of “{{name}}”, or a newer one.
brands.importInvalid: That isn’t a Steps brand file.
brands.fontDropped: {{family}} was left out: its licence doesn’t allow putting it in documents.
brands.coverLogoHelp: At the top of the first page, and in Word and web page exports.
brands.pageLogoHelp: Small, in the corner of every PDF page after the first.
brands.lowContrastFor: {{colour}} is hard to see on white.
brands.useDerived: Work it out from the main colour
brands.useDerivedFor: Work out {{colour}} from the main colour
brands.fontInstalled: The name of a font installed on this PC. PDFs include it when its licence allows; Word and web pages use it if the reader has it.
brands.fontUploaded: Uploaded into this brand, so PDFs can include it on any PC.
brands.fontInvalid: That isn’t a TrueType (.ttf) font of 4 MB or less.
brands.fontNotEmbeddable: {{family}}’s licence doesn’t allow putting it in documents, so it can’t be used.
brands.localFontsAsk: To put fonts installed on this computer into PDFs, Chrome needs to let Steps read them. They stay on this computer.
brands.localFontsDenied: Chrome is blocking installed fonts for Steps, so PDFs use a standard font instead. Allow “Fonts” in Steps’ site settings, or upload the .ttf.
brands.localFontsUnsupported: This browser can’t read installed fonts, so PDFs use a standard font instead. Upload the .ttf to include a font.
brands.darkHelp: Worked out for you so they read well on dark backgrounds. Set one here only if the brand has its own.
brands.managedImport: “{{name}}” is a brand your organisation manages, so a file can’t replace it.

privacy.intro: Steps reads the text in your screenshots on this PC (with Windows’ own offline text recognition) to suggest what to blur. Nothing is sent anywhere.
privacy.introLinux: Steps reads the text in your screenshots on this computer (with Tesseract, if it’s installed) to suggest what to blur. Nothing is sent anywhere.
privacy.introPage: Steps reads the text on the pages you record, as the browser shows it, to suggest what to blur. Nothing is sent anywhere.

strengthHelp.light: Suggests blurring emails, phone, card and bank numbers, and your always-blur words. You choose what to blur.
strengthHelp.standard: Also postcodes, National Insurance numbers, names and IDs beside their labels, and your own account names. You choose what to blur.
strengthHelp.thorough: Also file names, such as recent-file lists, and file paths. Expect more suggestions to look through. You choose what to blur.

privacy.termsHelp: Words or phrases to blur in every screenshot, such as a client’s name or an internal project code.
privacy.termLabel: Word or phrase to always blur
privacy.safeTermsHelp: Words that are fine to show, such as your company’s name or a test account. Nothing containing them is suggested for blurring.
privacy.cacheHelp: Kept on this PC only, to make suggestions quicker. Removed after 30 days unused.
privacy.cacheFailed: It couldn’t be cleared. Please try again.
privacy.notGuaranteed: Suggestions help, but they can miss things. Always look through the screenshots before sharing a guide.
privacy.recordPc: Record this PC’s name and my Windows login in guides
privacy.recordPcHelp: Kept with a guide’s saves and its password lock, and shown in its Properties to anyone who can open the library. Never in exports.

suggest.blurAllHelp: Blur every possible personal detail in every screenshot, in one go. One Undo takes it back.
suggest.blurAllNothing: No personal details found to blur. Suggestions can miss things, so check the screenshots yourself.
suggest.title: Possible personal details

findBlur.menuNote: Blur a word or personal data in every screenshot
findBlur.title: Find & Blur
findBlur.help: Search every screenshot for a word or phrase and blur each match. Leave the box empty to look for personal data: emails, phone numbers, postcodes, card numbers, National Insurance numbers, IBANs and your always-blur words, plus names, addresses, usernames, dates of birth and ID numbers filled in next to a label that says what they are.
findBlur.placeholder: Leave empty to find personal data
findBlur.unread_one: {{count}} screenshot couldn’t be read, so it wasn’t searched. Check it yourself.
findBlur.unread_other: {{count}} screenshots couldn’t be read, so they weren’t searched. Check them yourself.
findBlur.notGuaranteed: Suggestions can miss things. Check every screenshot before you share the guide.
findBlur.inText_one: It’s also in the wording or notes of step {{steps}}.
findBlur.inText_other: It’s also in the wording or notes of {{count}} steps ({{steps}}).

zoom.menuNote: Crops very wide screenshots around the click so they read well on a page
zoom.nothing: No screenshots need zooming: they already read well on a page.

exportSettings.ask: Ask where to save every time
exportSettings.askHelp: When off, exports go straight to the folder above, and never replace an existing file.
exportSettings.notLocal: Choose a folder on this PC’s drives. To save an export to a network folder, turn on “Ask where to save every time”.
exportSettings.optimiseHelp: Makes web page exports about half the size: pictures at most 1920 pixels wide, slightly softer.

errors.busy: A recording is already in progress.
errors.damagedFile: That file is damaged, so it can’t be opened.
errors.defaultLibrary: The default library can’t be removed. Make another library the default first.
errors.excludedApp: This app is excluded from recording, so it can’t be captured.
errors.folderMissing: The export folder isn’t available. Choose another in Settings.
errors.guideExists: A guide with this id is already in the library.
errors.guideNotFound: That guide isn’t in the library any more.
errors.indicatorLost: The recording bar isn’t responding, so recording can’t resume. Close and reopen Steps to review the steps so far.
errors.incompleteSession: This recording stopped before anything was captured.
errors.inputResumeFailed: Recording couldn’t resume. Try again, or stop and start a new recording.
errors.inputSourceFailed: The way clicks are read couldn’t be changed.
errors.inputUnavailable: Clicks can’t be read on this PC right now.
errors.keyboardUnavailable: What you type can’t be read on this PC right now. Start the recording without Record what’s typed.
errors.invalidExecutable: Choose an app captured during this recording.
errors.invalidId: That name or id isn’t valid.
errors.invalidInputSource: That way of reading clicks isn’t known.
errors.invalidPreferences: Enter a name of up to 120 characters and a full local folder for the library.
errors.invalidRequest: Something went wrong passing that to the app. Please try again.
errors.invalidShortcut: Use Ctrl or Alt with a letter, number or F-key.
errors.invalidState: That can’t be done right now.
errors.journalWriteFailed: Part of the recording couldn’t be saved, so it may be missing steps.
errors.libraryExists: That folder is already a library.
errors.libraryNotFound: That library isn’t in the list any more.
errors.monitorUnavailable: That monitor is no longer connected. Choose another.
errors.moveIncomplete: The guide was copied, but the original couldn’t be removed. Check both libraries.
errors.newerFormat: That was made by a newer Steps. Update the app to open it.
errors.noDraft: This recording has nothing to edit yet.
errors.notExportFile: Exports can only be saved as PDF, Word or web page files.
errors.notFont: That isn’t a TrueType font file (.ttf).
errors.notFound: That file isn’t there any more.
errors.notReady: The app is still starting. Try again in a moment.
errors.ocrFailed: The text in the screenshot couldn’t be read.
errors.originalsLeft: The blur is burned into the screenshots, but some unblurred originals couldn’t be deleted yet because another program (often OneDrive) has them open. Apply blur permanently again in a moment to finish.
errors.outsideTargetMonitor: Move the pointer onto the chosen monitor first.
errors.ownWindow: Move to the app you want to capture, then press the shortcut again.
errors.barCapture: The recording bar couldn’t be hidden from screenshots.
errors.barMove: The recording bar couldn’t be moved. You can drag it by its handle instead.
errors.lockLost: Someone else is editing this guide now, so this change wasn’t saved here. Your changes are kept as a draft on the guide.
errors.recordingActive: Save or discard the current recording before changing these settings.
errors.recordingPaused: Resume recording before adding this step.
errors.retakeOwnWindow: Steps was still in front when the screenshot was due. Try again, and bring the window you want to the front during the countdown.
errors.retakeWhileRecording: Stop the recording before retaking a screenshot.
errors.screenshotWriteFailed: A screenshot couldn’t be saved, so the recording may be missing it.
errors.secureDesktop: Recording carries on by itself when the lock screen or permission prompt closes.
errors.setByPolicy: Your organisation manages this, so it can’t be changed here.
errors.shortcutTaken: Windows or another app already uses that combination. Try another.
errors.startupOffInWindows: Windows has Start with Windows switched off for Steps. Switch it on in Windows Settings > Apps > Startup.
errors.stillRecording: Wait for recording to finish before saving the guide.
errors.storage: That couldn’t be saved or read: {{detail}}
errors.storageError: That couldn’t be saved or read: {{detail}}
errors.tooLate: New steps were recorded after starting again, so it can’t be undone.
errors.trashNotFound: That guide isn’t in the Bin any more.
errors.uiaUnavailable: The app couldn’t start reading what’s clicked. Try again.
errors.waylandSession: Steps can only record in an X11 session. Sign out, choose one at the sign-in screen (such as “Ubuntu on Xorg”), and sign in again, or use Steps for Chrome.
errors.unsavedEdits: Some changes couldn’t be saved yet, so this didn’t go ahead. Steps keeps trying; check the library folder is available, then try again.
errors.unsupportedImage: That picture can’t be used. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.versionNotFound: That version isn’t there any more.
errors.workerFailed: Recording stopped because capturing kept failing. The steps so far are kept.
errors.updatesOff: This copy of Steps doesn’t check for updates.
errors.updateWhileRecording: Stop the recording before restarting to update.
errors.updateCheckFailed: Couldn’t check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.updateDownloadFailed: The update couldn’t be downloaded, or it wasn’t signed by Amluto, so nothing was kept.
errors.updateInstallFailed: The update couldn’t be installed, so it will be downloaded again.
errors.folderAccess: Steps needs your permission to open the “{{detail}}” folder again. Choose Allow access on the guides page.
errors.guideLocked: {{detail}} locked this guide with a password. Enter it to change, move or delete the guide.

welcome.title: Welcome to Steps, {{name}}
welcome.body: A two-minute look at where things live. Skip any step, or end the tour whenever you like.

confirm.title: End the tour?
confirm.body: You can turn it back on any time in Settings.

ended.title: Turn it back on any time

done.title: You’re all set
done.body: That’s the tour. You can run it again from Settings whenever you like.

pill.label: Tour
pill.hide: Hide the Tour button for now
pill.hideTitle: Hide for now. Continue the tour is still in Settings → General.

record.title: Record a task
record.body: Press New recording, then do the task the way you always do. Every click becomes a step with its own screenshot, and a small bar stays on screen so you can pause or stop.

guides.title: Your guides
guides.body: Stopping opens the recording as a draft to check and save. Saved guides appear here: open one to edit its steps, blur anything private or add notes.

search.title: Find any guide
search.body: Search titles, tags and owners, and the words in every step.

export.title: Share it your way
export.body: Export a guide as a PDF, a Word document or an interactive web page, in your own colours and logo or a client’s: set them up in Settings → Brand profiles, or duplicate the Amluto one. Before anything leaves, you see every screenshot as it will look.
export.tryIt: Try it: click Export to see the formats, then close the menu.

import.title: Guides from other people
import.body: Import opens a guide that someone has sent you as an .amlsteps file.

views.title: Find your way around
views.body: All your guides, the ones you opened recently, and any that need a second look. Tags you add to guides appear underneath.

bin.title: Nothing goes by accident
bin.body: Deleted guides wait in the Bin for 30 days, and you can put them back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Libraries, including shared folders, apps that are never recorded, words that are always blurred, brands and keyboard shortcuts. You can run this tour again from Settings → General.

updates.title: Updates
updates.checks: Steps looks for a new version when it opens, at most once a day. It downloads one in the background and installs it the next time Steps opens.
updates.newest: Last checked {{date}} at {{time}}: you have the newest version.
updates.readyHelp: It installs the next time Steps opens. Restart now to install it straight away: Steps closes for a moment and opens the new version. Your guides aren’t touched.
updates.readyToast: Steps {{version}} is ready. It installs the next time Steps opens.
updates.store: The Microsoft Store keeps Steps up to date.
updates.msi: Your IT team installs new versions.
updates.policy: Your organisation has switched update checks off.
updates.none: This copy of Steps doesn’t check for updates.
updates.portable: This is the portable Steps: an update replaces the program where it is, and keeps its Steps data folder.
updates.readOnly: This portable Steps is in a folder it can’t change, so it can’t update itself. Download new versions from steps.amluto.com, or move it to a folder of your own.
updates.checkFailed: Couldn’t check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again.
updates.downloadFailed: The update couldn’t be downloaded, or it wasn’t signed by Amluto, so nothing was kept.
updates.installFailed: The update couldn’t be installed, so it will be downloaded again.
updates.automaticHelp: Looks for a new version at most once a day and downloads it in the background. Switched off, Steps never contacts the update server unless you press Check for updates.
updates.manual: Automatic updates are off: Steps only looks when you press Check for updates.

shortcutClash.one: Another app already uses {{keys}}, so “{{name}}” won’t work from the keyboard.
shortcutClash.other: Another app already uses {{count}} of Steps’ keyboard shortcuts, so they won’t work.

locks.lockBody: Nobody can change, move or delete it in Steps without the password, including you. Anyone can still view it, export it, duplicate it and merge it into a new guide. It will show “Locked by {{name}}”.
locks.outsideNote: This stops changes in Steps. It doesn’t stop someone changing the guide’s files directly, outside Steps.
locks.noRecovery: A forgotten password can’t be recovered, but the guide can always be duplicated.
locks.withRecovery: If the password is forgotten, your IT team can unlock it.
locks.mismatch: The two passwords aren’t the same.
locks.wait: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
locks.editorBanner: {{lockedBy}}. Enter the password to change it, or edit a copy.
locks.refused: {{name}} locked this guide. Unlock it to make changes.
locks.mergeKept: “{{title}}” is locked, so it stayed where it was.
locks.listBodyMove: These guides are locked, so they weren’t moved to {{name}}. Choose one and enter its password to move it. The password is tried on the others too, and any it opens are moved as well.
locks.listBodyBin: These guides are locked, so they weren’t moved to the Bin. Choose one and enter its password to move it there. The password is tried on the others too, and any it opens are moved as well.
locks.listBodyRemove: Choose a guide and enter its password to remove its lock. The password is tried on the others too, and any it opens are unlocked as well.
locks.savesNote: Saves are counted from Steps 1.0. Each time someone edits the guide and closes it counts as one.
locks.eventRecovery: Unlocked with the IT recovery password:
locks.eventBinned: Moved to the Bin, which removed the lock:
